title: Cyprus-registered metals trader named in customs inquiry
author: M. Andreou
body:
Customs authorities in Limassol confirmed on Monday that they had opened an inquiry
into alleged misdeclaration of consignment values by a metals trading company whose
director, Elena Vasquez, declined to comment.

No charges have been filed and Ms Vasquez has not been accused of any offence. The company
said in a later statement that the discrepancy arose from a clerical error.

The inquiry concerns consignments declared between January and December 2022.
